comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector terminal; record steers a laser through two mirrors while blocking the beam during adjustments.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-rich blade insertion and coupled extraction versus mirror pose adjustment, beam-path reasoning, and safe block placement/removal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact extraction and lacks numeric force/damage limits. Record requires two reflections to the detector center, no mirror motion while illuminated, no stray beam or falls, stillness, and release.
comparison.reason: The record is a geometric optical alignment and safety-sequencing task with no analogous latch or extraction mechanics.
